The memory deviation (z=84.05, 420%) is an order of magnitude weaker than the CPU deviation (z=629.73) in E1, which makes it secondary.
The all-services metric scan in E1 ranks only emailservice metrics as significant.

proposed_fix.description: Find and stop the CPU-hogging process or workload in the emailservice pod. Temporarily raise its CPU limits or scale out emailservice replicas, then watch whether latency-90 returns to baseline.
